field.label: Enable
field.comment: Enables llms.txt / llms-full.txt / JSONL generation and serving.

field.label: Exclude This Scope
field.comment: When yes, skip generation for this store (or all stores under this website if set at website scope).

field.label: Store Summary
field.comment: Optional one-line summary used as the spec-compliant blockquote on llms.txt. If empty, the store's Default Description (Design → HTML Head) is used.

field.label: Attribution Signature
field.comment: Appends a one-line "Generated by Angeo LlmsTxt" footer to llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and .md mirrors (never to JSONL). It credits the free open-source module and helps other merchants discover it. You are welcome to disable it — no features are affected.

field.label: Products under "## Optional"
field.comment: Default No since 4.0.0. llms.txt v2 (10 Aug 2026) removed the mechanical meaning of ## Optional — it no longer instructs any tool to drop those links, it is only a convention for secondary content. Products are a store's primary content, so they get their own ## Products section. Set to Yes only if you deliberately want them treated as secondary.

field.label: Product Limit
field.comment: Cap the number of products. 0 = unlimited.

field.label: CMS Identifiers to Exclude
field.comment: Comma- or newline-separated CMS page identifiers. Defaults: no-route, enable-cookies, privacy-policy-cookie-restriction-mode

field.label: Customer Group for Pricing
field.comment:
Product prices reflect this group's final price (special prices, group prices). Default: NOT LOGGED IN.
⚠ Security warning: the generated files are publicly accessible and CDN-cacheable. Selecting a logged-in / wholesale / B2B group publishes that group's negotiated pricing to anyone on the internet, including competitors. Only change this if that is explicitly intended.

field.label: Generate llms.txt
field.comment: Spec-compliant, compact markdown.

field.label: Generate llms-full.txt
field.comment: Same sections as llms.txt, but with full sanitized descriptions inline. Can be 5–50× larger.

field.label: Generate JSONL
field.comment: One JSON record per line; for vector indexing / embedding pipelines.

field.label: Serve /url-key.md Mirrors
field.comment: When yes, serves a clean Markdown version of every enabled and visible product/category/CMS page at {url}.md. Rendered on first request, then served from the Magento cache (TTL = HTTP Cache-Control TTL below; cache tag ANGEO_LLMS_MD).

field.label: Generate agents.md
field.comment: Serves an operator's manual for AI agents at /agents.md — interaction rules plus links to this store's machine-readable surfaces (llms.txt, UCP profile, MCP endpoint when the sibling Angeo modules are installed). Follows the storefront convention Shopify rolled out to all stores in May 2026. Also appends a "For Agents & Developers" section to llms.txt.

field.label: Emit Link Relations
field.comment: llms.txt v2 discoverability. Adds <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> and <link rel="describedby"> to the head of product, category and CMS pages, and sends the same pair as an HTTP Link: header on the served markdown mirrors. This is how an agent finds the markdown version of a page and the llms.txt that describes it without guessing. Requires Serve /url-key.md Mirrors.

field.label: Link to Markdown Mirrors in llms.txt
field.comment: llms.txt v2 asks that the links inside llms.txt point at LLM-friendly content. When yes, entity links in llms.txt and llms-full.txt use the .md mirror URL instead of the HTML page. Requires Serve /url-key.md Mirrors.

field.label: Serve Agentic Discovery Sitemap
field.comment: Serves /sitemap_agentic_discovery.xml, a small sitemap that declares only the agent-facing files (agents.md, llms.txt, and the other enabled formats). Submit it in Search Console next to your main sitemap. Mirrors what Shopify publishes.

field.label: Include Availability
field.comment: Exports the salable status of each product (in_stock in JSONL, In stock / Out of stock in the markdown formats). Availability is one of the two facts an AI shopping agent needs before it recommends a product; price is the other. Loaded in batch per collection page — no extra query per product.

field.label: Include Image URL
field.comment: Exports the absolute URL of the product's base image (image in JSONL, an image line in llms-full.txt). The original file is linked, not a resized cache variant.

field.label: Brand Attribute Code
field.comment: Attribute code holding the manufacturer or brand, e.g. manufacturer. Exported under the dedicated brand key so agents do not have to guess which attribute carries it. Leave empty if you have none.

field.label: Availability Source
field.comment: Auto reads salable status through Multi-Source Inventory when MSI is installed, and through the legacy stock index otherwise. This matters only if you run more than one stock: for a single Default Source / Default Stock setup — the large majority — MSI keeps the legacy index in sync and both answers are identical. Choose Legacy to force the old index, for example if the MSI lookup is slow on a very large catalogue. If MSI is asked and cannot answer, the module falls back to the legacy index and logs it rather than publishing a guess.

field.label: Additional Attributes
field.comment: Comma- or newline-separated attribute codes exported alongside the product, e.g. color, size, material, gtin. Dropdown values are exported as their store-view labels, not option IDs. Keep the list short: every code adds a column to each collection page. Empty values are omitted per product.

group.label: Agents.md Content
group.comment: Links surfaced to AI agents in /agents.md. Each field takes either an absolute URL or a path relative to the store base URL — a CMS page identifier such as shipping-policy works as-is. Empty fields are skipped, no empty headings are produced.

field.label: Resolve CMS Directives
field.comment: Renders {{widget}}, {{block}}, {{var}}, and {{store}} directives via Magento's frontend filter before stripping HTML. Applies to CMS pages and categories. When disabled, directive source is stripped (never leaked).

field.label: Resolve Directives in Product Content
field.comment: ⚠ Security: product descriptions often come from imported supplier/PIM feeds. Resolving {{block}}/{{widget}} directives in that content lets whoever controls the feed pull arbitrary block output into a publicly served file (template-directive injection). Keep No unless all product content is authored by trusted admins. When No, directives in product content are stripped instead of resolved.

field.label: Page Builder Strategy
field.comment: How to handle elements with data-content-type attributes (Page Builder output). Use Exclude for typical AEO; Allow for strict text-only mode.

field.label: Excluded Content-Types
field.comment: Comma- or newline-separated data-content-type values to DROP under the Exclude strategy. Defaults: products, banner, slider, slide, video, map, buttons, button-item, block, dynamic-block, divider, spacer. Known types: row, column-group, column, tabs, tab-item, text, heading, html, image, video, map, divider, spacer, buttons, button-item, banner, slider, slide, products, block, dynamic-block.

field.label: Allowed Content-Types
field.comment: Comma- or newline-separated data-content-type values to KEEP under the Allow strategy. Defaults: text, heading, html, tabs, tab-item, row, column, column-group.

field.label: Skip Generation When Nothing Changed
field.comment: Default No, on purpose. When yes, the nightly run skips a store whose products, categories, CMS pages and module configuration all pre-date its last successful generation — no catalog pass at all. The check reads entity timestamps, so it does not notice stock movements (the stock table has no timestamp) or prices changed by catalog rules or scheduled updates. If your availability or prices move without the product row being saved, leave this No and pay for the nightly pass. angeo:llms:generate --force always rebuilds.

field.label: Invalidate Markdown Mirror on Save
field.comment: Drops the cached .md mirror of a product, category or CMS page when it is saved or deleted, the same way Magento invalidates the cached HTML page. Without it an edited page keeps serving its previous markdown until the HTTP TTL expires. Only that entity's cache entries are removed, never the whole mirror cache. Costs one url_rewrite lookup per save — switch off if a large import measurably slows down.

field.label: Collection Page Size
field.comment: Number of products loaded per collection page during streaming. Default 500 (each page holds full descriptions in memory). Lower this if you hit memory limits; raise only on hosts with generous PHP memory.

field.label: Cache-Control TTL (seconds)
field.comment: Sent as Cache-Control: public, max-age= on the served files. Default 3600.

field.label: Cron Expression
field.comment: Standard cron expression. Default: 0 2 * * * (daily at 02:00 server time).
